Let the squared side lengths of the triangle be  
\[
X=\frac{481}{10},\quad Y=\frac{125}{2},\quad Z=\frac{328}{5}.
\]
Then
\[
X+Y+Z=\frac{881}{5},
\]
and
\[
X^2+Y^2+Z^2=\frac{526161}{50}.
\]
Using the area formula in terms of squared side lengths,
\[
16K^2=(X+Y+Z)^2-2(X^2+Y^2+Z^2).
\]
Thus
\[
16K^2=\left(\frac{881}{5}\right)^2-2\left(\frac{526161}{50}\right)
=\frac{776161}{25}-\frac{526161}{25}
=\frac{250000}{25}=10000.
\]
So
\[
K^2=625 \implies K=25.
\]

\[
\boxed{25}
\]
